content_html:
watched #2.0 – to start with I have seen many a posts where people are clebrating or making fun of the collections of this film…let me tell you
if this movie fails then Indian film industry doesnt deserve a creative genius like Shankar and he can comfortably move to Hollywood and that would be our greatest loss

How on earth Shankar can come up with these out of box concepts and visualization _/\_ pretty much like Hollywood movie the whole movie revolves around single concept and there are no unecessary distractions and commericial elements……Shakars visualisation is of top notch and it was always a challange for the CGI team to make Shankars dream a relaity. Story wise it is the only movie I have seen after Avatar which showcased Human race in negative and I pretty much loved that concept. AR Rahmans BGM is World class. and Fans get to see typical Rajini style in only last 30 mins.

Wonder what Shankar could have achieved if he hadnt faced challanges with the CGI team

Those who are commeting on the movie comparing with Bahubali….please note that Bahubali was a periodic drama with time and tested formula of Brothers revange ( story wise it didnt had any novality) but 2.0 is a futuristic Scifi film with superb and creative story…..And Bahubali was perfectly packaged and marketed with Business brain of Rajamouli. So stop talking nonsense and hive 2.0 its due credit. Shankar always comes with these unique story ideas (for I he came up with a story of a super successful model turned into a ugly beast due to a virus) and 2.0 on How mobiles make Humans run for their life _/\_
